definitions.explanation: A formal expression using numbers, variables, and mathematical symbols to represent a relationship or calculation.

examples.japanese: この{数式|すうしき}を{解|と}いてください。
{複雑|ふくざつ}な{数式|すうしき}をコンピュータで{計算|けいさん}した。
examples.english: I calculated the complex formula using a computer.

examples.japanese: {物理学|ぶつりがく}では、{自然現象|しぜんげんしょう}を{数式|すうしき}で{表|あらわ}すことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In physics, natural phenomena are often expressed using mathematical formulas.

notes:
USAGE:
{数式|すうしき} combines {数|すう} (number) and {式|しき} (expression, formula). It refers to any mathematical expression, from simple arithmetic to complex equations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数式|すうしき}を{解|と}く (to solve an equation)
- {数式|すうしき}を{立|た}てる (to set up an equation)
- {数式|すうしき}で{表|あらわ}す (to express in a formula)
- {数式|すうしき}{処理|しょり} (formula processing)
